heading: Waiver of mediation rights by borrowers
lead: No System institution may make a loan secured by a mortgage or lien on agricultural property to a borrower on the condition that the borrower waive any right under the mediation program of any State.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1994—Pub. L. 103–354 struck out “agricultural loan” before “mediation program”.
